findings.message: event 'cache.Changed' is subscribed (handler 'OnCache') to 'Cache' — a DI scoped service that outlives 'Vm'; the strong subscription promotes 'Vm' to the source's lifetime, so it can never be collected — a captive/region escape (leak, no release path)

event 'bus.Changed' is subscribed (handler '<lambda>') to 'Bus' — a DI singleton (application-lifetime) service that outlives 'Vm'; the strong subscription promotes 'Vm' to the source's lifetime, so it can never be collected — a captive/region escape (leak, no release path — and being an inline lambda it has no '-=' handle, so it could never be detached)

event 'SystemEvents.Session' is subscribed (handler '<lambda>') to a static (process-lived) event source that outlives 'Vm'; the strong subscription promotes 'Vm' to the source's lifetime, so it can never be collected — a region escape (leak, no release path — and being an inline lambda it has no '-=' handle, so it could never be detached)
